title: CDR - Loop Detection
description: Calls that left one entity and re-entered the network through another instead of terminating, identified by the same ANI and DNIS appearing on more than one entity within a short window.

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip ORDER BY entity
list.label: CDR Source
list.name: entity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip ORDER BY entity

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT orig_trunk_group_name FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND orig_trunk_group_name != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) ORDER BY orig_trunk_group_name
list.label: Customer Trunk
list.name: origin_trunk
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT orig_trunk_group_name FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND orig_trunk_group_name != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) ORDER BY orig_trunk_group_name

list.name: loop_min_entities
list.label: Loop: min entities
list.description: A pair must appear on at least this many entities to count as a loop. 2 means the same ANI+DNIS was seen on one entity and then another.

list.name: loop_min_legs
list.label: Loop: min legs
list.description: Minimum call legs for the pair. Filters ordinary retries from genuine loops.

list.name: loop_window_sec
list.label: Loop: window (sec)
list.description: All legs must fall within this many seconds. A routing loop re-enters the network almost immediately.

list.name: loop_row_limit
list.label: Loop: max rows
list.description: Row cap for the Loop Detection table.

panels.title: Looping calls - every leg (latest ${loop_row_limit})
panels.description: Every call leg belonging to a looping ANI+DNIS pair, grouped together so the legs of one loop sit on consecutive rows. A loop is the same ANI and DNIS seen on more than one entity inside the window set above. Columns show which entity took the leg, the customer trunk it came in on, the vendor and vendor trunk it went out to, and the SIP reason it ended with. Export via the panel menu: Inspect > Data > Download CSV.

targets.rawSql: WITH looping_pairs AS ( SELECT cityHash64(from_did, to_did) AS pair_hash FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND notEmpty(from_did) AND notEmpty(to_did) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY pair_hash HAVING uniqUpTo(4)(entity) >= ${loop_min_entities} AND count() >= ${loop_min_legs} AND max(event_time) - min(event_time) <= ${loop_window_sec} ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 500) SELECT call_start_time AS `Time`, from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, entity AS `Entity`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, term_carrier_name AS `Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Vendor Trunk`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `SIP Reason`, if(sip_code = 200, 'Answered', 'Failed') AS `Result`, duration_real AS `Duration Sec`, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND notEmpty(from_did) AND notEmpty(to_did) AND cityHash64(from_did, to_did) IN (SELECT pair_hash FROM looping_pairs) ORDER BY from_did, to_did, event_time, record_key LIMIT ${loop_row_limit}
